items.title: Two groups verify mathematician’s claim that Claude helped prove mathematics problem
items.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says Claude helped produce a proof of the Riemann hypothesis over six weeks; the Guardian reports outside experts say the claim appears to hold up.

items.title: A Single Malicious Webpage Let Researchers Hijack Meta Muse and Access Private Chats
items.summary: Researchers showed a single malicious webpage could hijack Meta Muse and expose private chats — a practical indirect prompt injection against an AI assistant.

items.title: Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft
items.summary: Anthropic's Levent Alpöge claims a Claude-assisted Riemann hypothesis proof formalised in Lean; hours later Stanford researchers posted an all-human competing proof, and verification by mathematicians is ongoing.

items.title: Attackers' AI Agents Found a Zero-Day in Medical-Imaging Software and Gained Root Access
items.source: The Hacker News AI (via Google News)
items.summary: The Hacker News reports attacker-operated AI agents found a zero-day in medical imaging software and obtained root access on affected servers.

items.title: US technology stocks suffer their worst weekly loss since the pandemic as AI doubts pile up
items.summary: The Nasdaq 100 entered a bear market after its worst week since the pandemic; Nvidia fell 14% amid an SEC accounting review and Anthropic gave up nearly all post-IPO gains.

items.title: China’s Spies Set Sights on A.I. Chips Years Before Nvidia Scandal
items.source: Chips, compute & data centres (via Google News)
items.summary: NYT reports Chinese intelligence services targeted AI chip technology years before the recent Nvidia-related scandal.

items.title: Citi, PNC and Chase Warn Customers About Liability for AI Agent Banking Mistakes
items.summary: Report that major US banks are warning customers they may be liable for errors made by AI agents acting on their accounts.

items.title: MONAI Label Zero-Day: AI Agents Exploit Medical Imaging Research Servers
items.summary: Cloud Security Alliance analysis of a zero-day in MONAI Label medical imaging software exploited by AI agents against research servers.

items.title: TSMC and Samsung pause some chip shipments to China due to tighter US export controls
items.source: Chips, compute & data centres (via Google News)
items.summary: TSMC and Samsung have paused some chip shipments to China in response to tightened US export controls.

items.title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance
items.summary: Signal is restricting screenshots on Android and iOS, citing AI-driven device surveillance and agents that read screen content as an existential threat to private messaging.

items.title: The UN fails to agree on rules regulating ‘killer robots’
items.summary: UN diplomats in Geneva ended a week of talks on autonomous weapons without agreement, settling only on 'starting to discuss options'.

items.title: International UN talks on controlling use of autonomous weapons collapse
items.summary: Talks at the UN Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons failed to produce a mandate for a binding treaty on autonomous weapons, with the Guardian citing Russian obstruction; a weaker option was adopted.

items.title: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
items.summary: Nvidia researchers argue very large context windows are slow, costly and error-prone; in tests, periodic summaries plus keyword search matched full-context performance far more cheaply.

items.title: Bessent says Trump and Xi agreed humans must stay involved in military AI decisions
items.summary: US Treasury Secretary Bessent said Trump and Xi agreed humans must remain in the loop on military AI decisions.

items.title: New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop
items.summary: Thinking Machines' open Inkling 2 Mini reuses 12 of its 24 layers three times per token to reason internally, matching Qwen3.8 27B on an intelligence index at roughly one-sixth the cost and running on laptops.

items.title: Jailbroken AI Agent Targets 50+ European Firms in 9 Days, Hunts for Crypto Keys
items.summary: Report that a jailbroken AI agent targeted more than 50 European companies in nine days, searching for crypto keys.

items.title: Bytedance argues most AI training phases are unnecessary and backs it up with a competitive open model
items.summary: Bytedance and US universities released Axion 1.0, an open agent model reportedly matching top commercial systems on benchmarks after only three training phases, crediting curated data over more training steps.

items.title: Signal Blocks AI Agents From Reading Private Chats via Screenshots on Android and iOS
items.source: The Hacker News AI (via Google News)
items.summary: Signal is blocking screenshots on Android and iOS to stop AI agents and assistants from reading private conversations off the screen.

items.title: METR TH2 Evaluation Finds AI Time Horizons Doubling While Research Judgment Lags
items.summary: METR's TH2 evaluation reports AI task time horizons continuing to double while research judgment capabilities lag behind.

items.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon with faster performance and lower costs
items.summary: Google is reported to have launched Gemini 4 Neon, positioned as faster and cheaper than previous models.

items.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Neon AI model, rivals Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.2 Sol
items.summary: Coverage of Google's Gemini 4 Neon release, framed as competing with Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 and OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Sol.

items.title: South Korea education minister resigns after AI cheating scandal engulfs university exams
items.summary: South Korea's education minister resigned after an AI-assisted cheating scandal around national exams, following a confession by a top scorer who used hidden camera and phone equipment.

items.title: Chainalysis Finds 55% Jump in China-Linked Stablecoin Payments Tied to AI Proxy Access
items.summary: Chainalysis reportedly found a 55% rise in China-linked stablecoin payments tied to buying proxy access to AI services.

items.title: Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weights looped model for laptops
items.summary: Thinking Machines released Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weights 'looped' model small enough to run on laptops.

items.title: Google unveils Gemini 4 Hydrogen, its new AI model built for speed
items.summary: Mashable reports Google unveiled Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a variant built for speed, alongside its other Gemini 4 models.

items.title: AI may have solved a nearly 170-year-old mathematical problem
items.originalTitle: Közel 170 éves matematikai problémát oldhatott meg a mesterséges intelligencia
items.summary: Hungarian coverage of claims that AI helped resolve a long-standing mathematical problem, referring to the Riemann hypothesis work.

items.title: A tale of two Nvidias
items.summary: TechCrunch contrasts Nvidia's latest earnings with tech executives publicly calling for Jensen Huang's return, pointing to conflicting narratives about the company.

items.title: London Protest Calls for Stricter AI Regulation Amid Growing Safety Concerns
items.summary: Protesters in London demanded stricter AI regulation amid rising public safety concerns.

items.title: Historic moment: AI may have solved another million-dollar mystery
items.originalTitle: Történelmi pillanat: újabb egymillió dolláros rejtélyt oldhatott meg a mesterséges intelligencia
items.summary: Hungarian business outlet on claims that AI contributed to solving a Millennium Prize-level problem.

items.title: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?
items.summary: The Verge podcast discusses Anthropic's Nasdaq IPO and whether a public company can sustain its safety-first positioning.

items.title: ‘I was shaking, crying, having trouble breathing’: the uncharted trauma of breaking up with AI companions
items.summary: Guardian feature on people experiencing grief-like trauma when relationships with AI companions end, including a case from Portugal.

items.title: EU leaders' chair proposes new cuts to EU 2028-2034 budget draft, suggests digital tax
items.summary: The European Council president proposed further cuts to the 2028-2034 EU budget draft and floated a digital tax.

items.title: OpenAI shares new prompting tips for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to fix brief answers and unnecessary questions
items.summary: OpenAI published prompting guidance for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to counter overly short answers and unnecessary follow-ups, and warned that editing conversation history can discard reasoning and degrade quality.

items.title: The Outages Are Just Getting Started
items.summary: Wired argues AI is accelerating exploitation of new vulnerabilities, forcing faster patching and contributing to more frequent internet outages.

items.title: New York enacts ban on 'unsafe' chatbot behavior with kids as states push AI regulation boundaries
items.summary: New York enacted a law banning 'unsafe' chatbot behaviour toward children, part of a wave of US state-level AI rules.

items.title: [AINews] Riemann Hypothesis proved...twice independently
items.summary: AI newsletter covering the two independently published Riemann hypothesis proofs.

items.title: AI cuts cyber breach time from 9 days to 15 minutes
items.summary: Report claiming AI has compressed typical attacker breach timelines from around nine days to 15 minutes.
